capabilities: Define selector properties and their allowed options centrally in plugin settings
Replace text inputs with dropdowns in the Properties view
Inject dropdowns into table cells in Bases views
Sync selector changes between the Properties view and open Bases tables
Set the first option as the default value for files created from a Bases view
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; manual installation steps are given. Requires Obsidian 1.8.0+ and manipulates the DOM of the Properties and Bases views, so it may break when Obsidian's core UI changes.
intentEvidence: dynamically injects these dropdowns into both the standard Properties View
problem: Obsidian's Properties view and Bases tables only offer plain text inputs, so users must type option values by hand and risk typos in status- or priority-like properties.

relations.evidence: inside the tables generated by the core Obsidian Bases plugin

summary: Property enhancement plugin that renders designated frontmatter properties as interactive dropdown menus with predefined options in the Properties view and Bases tables.
